title: Implement scoped owner workspace and versioned catalog APIs
acceptance_criteria: Commit scoped order/customer/snapshot/history migrations and real summaries, stable list/detail pagination, and atomic status transitions with actor/history and stale-state conflicts.

Support all 12 manifest IDs in tenant tariffs with bounded integer KZT, basis-point conversion, transactional validation, and revision preconditions; reject invalid or stale updates without partial writes.

Implement sanitized profile, logo reference, publication and slug changes, plus current-password account updates with session rotation. Verify distinct owner data and true zeros using disposable DB fixtures.
deliverables: Workspace API and migrations, revision/DTO contracts for owner UI and live flow, and two-owner DB assertions
